summary: The player as PlayerActivity draws it: a cinema preloader while a copy is prepared, then no header at all — one bottom gradient with the title row, a full-width timeline and a single transport line. Live drops the timeline, the elapsed pair, speed and rewind; the error, track-menu and up-next cards sit over the picture.

meta.description: The note beside the title: year, genre and runtime, or the live programme and minutes left.

certificate.description: Age rating in an outlined badge. A live channel never shows one.

quality.description: The resolution the decoder is actually showing (e.g. 1080p), not the one the menu asked for.

peers.description: P2P peers feeding this copy; appended to the quality pill as '· 12 peers'.

duration.description: Seconds. Live has no timeline and no elapsed pair.

skipIntro.description: The one control outside the chrome: it stays while the transport is hidden.

series.description: Shows the Next episode and Episodes stops; a film has neither.

liveNow.description: The live note line: programme name and minutes left.

next.description: The up-next card: code, title and countdown.

menu.description: The centred track sheet: kind, current value and rows.

error.description: The centred failure card: heading, humanised message and the chips for this mode.
